findings.status: Existing historical finding independently reconnected to 95e source; no new count.
findings.observation: Position and Displacement have pub(super) native backing fields and frame markers, despite finite-value checked constructors and deserialize paths. Code in their parent spatial_geometry module and descendants can construct or mutate those fields without those admission checks. The current sibling SpatialBounds::union uses this visibility for componentwise min/max selection of existing typed endpoints, not a demonstrated invalid caller.
findings.condition_and_limits: The first failed contract is representable under Rust field visibility and independent of a claimed runtime incident. No currently reachable sibling creates or mutates a nonfinite value in the bounded source we read. The existing union uses already-admitted input components; exact framework/reflection routes and every other sibling remain separately scoped.
findings.future_repair_direction: Reconcile finite-value authority at the coordinate owner and expose suitable checked or invariant-preserving same-frame component selections for legitimate bounds union; preserve signed values, signed-zero selection behavior and avoid inventing fallback or unnecessary rechecks. No repair performed.

findings.status: Existing /root/mhr_character question, corroborated by fresh current decoder support; not a new count.
findings.observation: SceneDoor and SceneWindow decode each direction independently through SpatialDirection::from_normalized, and construct fields independently; individual unit checks do not establish a coherent paired tangent/outward basis, hinge, yaw or opening identity.
findings.condition_and_limits: Whether orthogonality or a stronger frame relation is required, and whether any incoherent independently constructed or decoded leaf can reach a relying supported consumer, are unproved. No native output or runtime effect is claimed.
relationships: 774 RIG-ADMISSION03-CONTRACT-065 and ROOT-ADM03-PARALLEL-177 already leave the same aggregate question open. 059 q407 SEGOVB-L13-WALL-LOCAL-FRAME-RETENTION and q2244 window projection are related but not automatically aliases; distinct first sites and actual ownership remain central decisions.

nonfindings_and_open_questions.assessment: Position translation and displacement subtraction re-enter checked constructors; signed finite positions, elevation and zero displacement are deliberately valid. No arithmetic overflow acceptance is inferred. Bounds centre/extent similarly re-admit calculations, but all producers/recipients remain open.

LeafDimensions specifically requires positive finite three axes and deserializes through that constructor, whereas CuboidDimensions deliberately permits zero. PlanDimensions is positive while PlanExtents permits zero; PlanDimensions halves may underflow to zero, which the extent type allows. These are separate semantic policies, not a universal minimum.

Finite unwrapped radians and checked unit quaternion are separate meanings. Direction decode requires a normalized vector; from_vector explicitly validates then applies native normalization. Native Bevy edge conditions, reflection contracts and all producer callers are not re-proved by these local bodies.

The bounded consumer takes admitted LeafDimensions and maps them to native size or leaf compiler. Asset lifecycle, native library behavior, independent alternate construction and actual display outcomes remain outside scope.

No relevant string-dispatch boundary in assigned bodies; serde formatting is an adapter and error causes are retained until formatting. No broad string clearance.

Finite signed positions, zero-valid translations, positive leaf/plan dimensions and zero-valid extents have different semantics; preserve them, including representable subnormal halves.
Scene leaf records carry related independently typed fields; supported aggregate and orthogonal basis policy remain open rather than a demanded arbitrary enum conversion.
Checked constructors and serde paths validate their leaf domains, but pub(super) coordinate backing provides a distinct internal bypass route already recorded as ROOT-ADM-F003.
